name: suite1-reborn-main-b895e352-stock
question: How does borg-reborn-rs main b895e352, with its own default settings, play the 999 saved encounters of Suite 1?
owner_authorization: 2026-11-20: the owner said "do 1, 2 and 3": a Suite 1 smoke on main b895e352, the first main on upstream Angband 574b618c (borg-reborn-rs #730), to learn whether the saved encounters still load on the new engine. Later stages on the owner's go.
prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result was read (borg-zoo#183). A sanity check of main: the 999 saves of
Suite 1 with its protocol (exact 2,000-engine-turn horizon, the suite's 30-second native wall limit, fresh Borg
memory, saved engine RNG). Settings: the checkout's own harness/borg.txt (sha256 315a4bd7...), nothing
overridden; the scary list it names (scary_monsters.txt 6ed44686...) is frozen with the inputs. Stages smoke 18,
then small 90, medium 360, big 900 and full 999, each after the previous stage's gate and proposed to the owner.
Gate at every stage: no missing, invalid or stopped cell; one binary; every cell's native receipts show the save,
the RNG, the borg-rs core, every borg.txt setting written, every borg_param_* effective from borg.txt, and an
initial pack/equipment/rune hash equal to the suite's. Reported alone: the death share, deaths per class and every
scenario's outcome. Encounters from one life are correlated.
